headerDisplay: Adds a fan in Apple Home for every room on your Roborock map. Turning the fan on cleans that room; the fan speed sets the suction power (25% Quiet, 50% Balanced, 75% Turbo, 100% Max). The Rooms list above controls which rooms get a fan and how many passes each one does; the defaults are set below. The room fans use no Roborock routines, so the app's 10-routine limit does not apply. The routines you do have in the Roborock app can be added as switches from the Routines list above. A routine or room clean started from the Roborock app shows on its switch or fan too. The Map camera box adds a camera that shows the robot's map.

language.title: Language / שפה
language.description: Language of the plugin settings and of the names the plugin makes up itself. Changed with the Language box at the top of the plugin settings.

email.title: Roborock account email
email.description: Filled in automatically when you log in above.

nameTemplate.title: Fan name
nameTemplate.description: {room} is replaced by the room name from the Roborock app, e.g. "Clean {room}" or "ניקוי {room}". Empty: "Clean {room}" ("ניקוי {room}" in Hebrew).

autoRooms.title: Create a fan for every room

suction.title: Starting fan speed / suction
suction.description: The level each fan starts at. After that each fan remembers the last speed you chose in Apple Home.

oneOf.title: Don't change (use the robot's current setting)

repeat.title: Passes
repeat.description: Default for every room and combination. A room or combination can have its own number in the lists above.

restoreSettings.title: Restore the previous suction/mop setting when the clean ends
restoreSettings.description: So cleans started from the Roborock app or Siri keep using your usual settings.

excludeRooms.title: Rooms without an automatic fan
excludeRooms.description: Managed from the Rooms list at the top of the plugin settings.

roomSettings.title: Per-room settings
roomSettings.description: Managed from the Rooms list at the top of the plugin settings.

room.title: Room name (as in the Roborock app)

programs.title: Custom programs (each one is another fan)

rooms.title: Rooms (names as in the Roborock app; leave empty for every room)

robot.title: Robot (only if you have more than one)

routines.title: Routines shown in Apple Home (each one is a switch)
routines.description: Managed from the Routines list at the top of the plugin settings.

name.title: Routine name (as in the Roborock app)

routineNameTemplate.title: Switch name
routineNameTemplate.description: {routine} is replaced by the routine name from the Roborock app, e.g. "{routine}" or "תוכנית {routine}".

followExternal.title: Show cleans started outside Apple Home
followExternal.description: When a routine or a room clean is started from the Roborock app, a schedule or another plugin, the matching switch or fan turns on in Apple Home and turns off when the clean ends. It is recognised by the rooms the robot is cleaning.

mapCamera.title: Add a camera that shows the robot's map
mapCamera.description: A camera in Apple Home with the robot's live map: the rooms in colour, the path it drove, where it is now and its status. Read and drawn by this plugin itself, with no other plugin or script (the live view uses ffmpeg). Set it up in the Map camera box above.

mapCameraName.title: Camera name
mapCameraName.description: Default: the robot's name followed by "Map".

mapColors.title: Your own colours
mapColors.description: Colours that replace those of the chosen style, as #rrggbb.

room.title: Room name (as in the Roborock app)

mapLabels.title: Write the room names on the map

mapStatus.title: Show the status line (what the robot is doing, battery)

ffmpegPath.title: Path to ffmpeg (optional)
ffmpegPath.description: Only for the map camera's live view, and only when ffmpeg is not found by itself.

skipDevices.title: Robots to ignore (name or device id)

enableMaxPlus.title: Add Max+ as the top fan speed (only for robots that have Max+)
enableMaxPlus.description: With this on the fan has 5 steps: 20% Quiet, 40% Balanced, 60% Turbo, 80% Max, 100% Max+.

robotIp.title: Robot IP address (optional)
robotIp.description: Normally found automatically. Commands are sent directly to the robot on your network, with the Roborock cloud as backup.

batteryOnFans.title: Show the battery level and charging state on every fan and routine switch
batteryOnFans.description: Open a fan's or switch's settings in Apple Home to see the robot's battery and whether it is on the dock charging. With this on you can turn the separate charging sensor off, unless you use it in automations.

chargingSensor.title: Add a charging sensor for each robot
chargingSensor.description: A contact sensor: closed while the robot is on the dock charging (or fully charged), open while it is off the dock. It also shows the battery level.

chargingSensorName.title: Charging sensor name
chargingSensorName.description: Default: the robot's name + "Charging", e.g. "S8 Charging". You can write e.g. "שואב בטעינה".

statusInterval.title: Check the robot's status every (seconds)
statusInterval.description: How often the robot is asked for its status while it sits on the dock. Away from the dock it is asked every 30 seconds, and changes the robot reports itself (leaving the dock, battery level) show up right away.
